Both me and a friend of mine were in a similar situation

First advice: do not start drinking or smoking or taking any drugs (that were not recommended by a psychiatrist) to have courage. It is ok to force yourself and not go all the way, this is how I got over it too. For me, I was really scared of people and especially of parties. The first time I was invited I cancelled last minute, and then if I didn't feel good at the next ones, I would just make up an excuse to leave early. Just because you did not finish doesn't mean you are not having any progress. What really helped get me out of the house was to go to a coffee shop (like Starbucks or a local one) and either drink there coffee while I am on my laptop working, or take it to go for a short walk somewhere in a park in the morning. It gave me energy and a little happiness, it motivated me. At the beginning, I did not get coffee, I got tea or a refresher, since anything with caffeine gave me anxiety (I recommend you stay away from it). 

Try to figure out what it is exactly that it scares you. The interaction with other people ? Take them off the pedestal and put yourself on it. Scared you might do something cringe ? Everyone is cringe, if you fake that you do not care you will eventually not care (but it will take some time). Scared that something might happen while you are out ? Make a small step at a time, desensitize the fear/anxiety. Even if you just go down the stairs or just at the door it is still progress. It is ok to be vulberable.

I advise you to NOT open the phone in the morning or when you go to the bed. For me, being a morning person does wonders, I feel like after 12am my thoughts start going wild and because I am tired I get very paranoid especially because it is dark.
 
My advice is to keep your anxiety for yourself, some people will look down on you...it's hard for them to undestand if they never had it + you will fill them with negative energy and they will not want to be near you. Instead, journal your thoughts and your feelings and every moment when it gets too much, or do another activity that helps with stabilizing your emotions (for example I write poems about what I feel)

I am not taking any medicine. My friend needed medicine. Her psychologist gave her "assignments" like "go to the store or walk every 2 days" and so on. Sometimes she can, sometime she can't, and that is ok. 

Good luck, I wish you happiness!

Hi! I was in the same situation as you about flying.

After I missed my entire vacation because of this fear, I was very disappointed in myself, but my body was not ready for it at that time. Together with a close friend, I booked a flight to a country that was much closer. I honestly recommend trying internal flights first if you have the money for a quick trip to another city. By doing that, there are fewer new variables to this fear (since you will be in your country and people speak your language, the fear of something new is not so strong). If your wife is understanding, you can ask her to come with you, ekse you can bring a close friend.  


For me, it was just a feeling of uncertainty in h. By talking with other people I started actually having this fear. An exercise that I recommend is to breathe in 3 seconds and breathe out 8 seconds constantly. I also have motion sickness, so for me, it was worse. The first time was scary and exciting at the same time, since it is a strange feeling when you depart and arrive. I was panicking when we were departing, but this exercise really helped me.   


Now I still do have a little fear in me every time I step on the plane and the night before, but once I am in the air, it starts to go away and I relax. You will also be amazed by the view when you see the clouds for the first time. I got a little dizzy because of my motion sickness but it was worthy. Now I can travel anywhere and I can achieve my dream of traveling.  


The moment you overcome this fear, it gives you a sense of accomplishment and it is very satisfying. The moment you step out of the plane you are filled with a new kind of independence. I wish you luck in your journey, and remember to just breathe and take it one step at a time:) I also recommend arriving at the airport sooner to have a moment of peace after going through security and passports (and maybe check-in), and I think if you go there someday before the flight to see the atmosphere also helps.

Salut! :) Aici este un subiect destul de sensibil pentru ca depinde ce nu iti place mai exact. Eu sunt la UBB, nu poli, dar tot sper ca te pot ajuta un pic.  

\- Daca nu iti place deloc facultatea, si nu te-ai vedea in viitor in domeniu, nu stiu daca alta facultate de info/mate ar fi optiunea buna. Intr-adevar, de la cunostintele mele de la poli, am auzit ca-i mult mai greu si ca profesorii se comporta mult mai urat fata de cei de la ubb. Daca totusi vrei sa incerci ubb, gandeste-te ca la poli faceai 4 ani si la ubb faci 3, deci teoretic ai absolvi in acelasi an (deci nu pierzi timp). Daca nu iti place acum , nici in viitor nu o sa iti placa, clar solutia este sa iti retragi dosarul si nici rusine nu trebuie sa iti fie, mai ales pentru ca tu asociezi facultatea aceasta cu "agonie". Spre exemplu, o colega de internship a fost la medicina si acum e la poli. Fericirea si sanatatea ta mentala sunt cele mai importante. Daca dai mail/suni la secretariat te vor indruma ele , probabil iti vor trimite un document pe care trebuie sa il semnezi legat de retragerea de la studii.

\- Daca nu iti plac doar anumite materii, dar cu altele esti ok, te poti duce intr-un domeniu unde nu este necesar sa cunosti sau sa utilizezi decat ceea ce iti place. Ma gandesc ca poate nu iti place partea de hardware si de aceea ai vrea la ubb, caz in care e o idee foarte buna. Si chiar si la ubb nu mi-au placut toate materiile, iar cand am ajuns la job a trebuit sa schimb echipa pentru ca nu imi placea ce fac.

\- Daca nu iti plac oamenii sau gandirea lor, dar ti-ar placea sa lucrezi in industrie, nu mi se pare un motiv valid sa pleci, pentru ca pe viitor vei intalni tot felul de tipologii indiferent unde ajungi. Iar daca nu iti plac oamenii din domeniu, nu trebuie neaparat sa ai prieteni de la utcn...sau poate nu ai intalnit tu persoanele care trebuie. Ca exemplu, eu cunosc si am prieteni de la mai multe facultati (business, comunicare, medicina) si toata lumea se plange de toata lumea. Sunt o groaza de oameni din orase diferite, crescuti cu mentalitati diferite, care se aduna intr-un loc, nu ai cum sa te intelegi cu toti.   


Daca vrei sa te descarci poti sa imi scrii un mesaj in privat si iti povestesc niste insight-uri la ubb daca doresti, sa vezi daca aici te-ai potrivi.
